No other 'no law' wording in the post, video page or package copy.
dispositions.quote_before: No law requires a CPTED review, but a lighting or door problem you've been told about and haven't fixed is the kind of thing that can matter later.
dispositions.quote_after: Use Oakland's checklist as a voluntary maintenance self-audit. If you plan alterations or permit work, ask the city whether project-specific CPTED review or other conditions apply. Either way, a lighting or door problem you've been told about and haven't fixed is the kind of thing that can matter later.
